title: Nightly server monitoring
subtitle: Automatic overnight checks, followed by a morning analyst review.
caption: Next: confirm the root cause, fix the problem and ask users to verify. Replay restarts the flow; Esc clears a selection. System reduced-motion settings are respected.

nodes.label: Start nightly
nodes.description: Run on schedule. Read since each log's last successful scan and report coverage gaps.

nodes.label: Connect to servers
nodes.description: Use permitted read access. Record unreachable servers and access failures.

nodes.label: Read event logs
nodes.description: Read System, Application and Security channels. Administrative Events is a combined view of underlying channels. Keep server, time, provider, event ID and message.

nodes.label: Select & filter
nodes.description: The automated script selects events, groups repeats and filters approved noise. Categories include Warning, Error, Critical and security audit rules. Retain evidence, unknown events and unusual spikes.

nodes.label: Review morning email
nodes.description: The morning server report contains selected events, affected servers, evidence and trends, next checks and scan failures. Review this information and decide what to investigate.

nodes.label: Configuration
nodes.description: Configuration supplies the server list, schedule and approved noise rules.

nodes.label: Evidence archive
nodes.description: Evidence archive retains raw evidence and repeat counts.
